newsitem.title: CHINA: Shenzhen bourse sets movement limits for shares.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen bourse sets movement limits for shares.

text.p: The Shenzhen stock exchange on Friday set daily movement limits for all shares and funds at 10 percent in either direction with effect from next Monday, an exchange announcement said.
Earlier, the Shanghai stock exchange made a similar announcement.
The Shenzhen announcement said the new rules covered all domestic A shares, foreign exchange B shares and investment fund units.
From Monday on, all bids and asks exceeding the limits are null and void and brokerages are banned from accepting invalid bids and asks, the announcement said.
The decision has been approved by the China Securities Regulatory Commission, the top securities watchdog, the announcement said.
Brokers said the decision was taken after dramatic rises and falls in the prices of securities on both the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock exchanges in recent weeks and months.
